daily.title: Record and create in Play
daily.text: Record, import, and preview media in Play. Image, Video, and Audio keep their drafts when you switch tabs, and model-specific controls cover options such as GIF frames, video sound, and audio stem separation. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Ask Play to Decide
daily.text: Ask a yes/no question, choose between options, or score a scale in Play’s Decide workspace. See the answer and its probabilities, then copy a JSON curl request for the decisions API. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Seedream 5.5 images
daily.text: Generate or edit images with paid-only `bytedance-seed/seedream-5-5`. Use up to ten reference images and choose 1K or 2K output. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=bytedance-seed/seedream-5-5).

daily.title: MiniMax H3 Image
daily.text: Generate and edit images with paid-only `minimax/minimax-h3-image`. It accepts up to 16 reference images and supports 1K, 2K, and 4K output. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax/minimax-h3-image).

daily.title: MiniMax H3 Image Highspeed
daily.text: Try the separate paid-only `minimax/minimax-h3-image-highspeed` model for generation and edits with up to 16 references at 1K, 2K, or 4K. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax/minimax-h3-image-highspeed).

daily.title: Kling 3.0 Pro video
daily.text: Make paid-only 1080p video from text or images with Kling 3.0 Pro. Use up to two reference frames, choose 3 to 15 seconds, and optionally add synchronized audio. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Seedance 2.5 Flash video
daily.text: Generate paid-only video with `bytedance/seedance-2.5-flash` from a prompt, up to two first and last keyframes, or image, video, and audio references. Keyframes and references cannot be combined in one request. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=bytedance/seedance-2.5-flash).

daily.title: HeyGen Avatar 6
daily.text: Animate a photo or illustrated-character reference video with paid-only `heygen/heygen-avatar-6`. Supply one speech audio reference to set the video length, then choose 1080p or 2K output. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=heygen/heygen-avatar-6).

daily.title: HeyGen Avatar 6 Turbo
daily.text: Use paid-only `heygen/heygen-avatar-6-turbo` to animate a photo or reference video from one speech audio track. Speech sets the duration; output supports 1080p or 2K. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=heygen/heygen-avatar-6-turbo).

daily.title: Muse Ember text model
daily.text: Try paid-only `meta/muse-ember` with text or image input. It supports tools and reasoning, with a 1,048,576-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=meta/muse-ember).

daily.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
daily.text: Send text, images, audio, or video to paid-only `google/gemini-4-hydrogen`. It returns text and supports tools, search, reasoning, and a 1,048,576-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-4-hydrogen).

daily.title: Gemini Decision 1
daily.text: Score yes/no, multiple-choice, or ordered-scale questions with paid-only `google/gemini-decision-1` through `/alpha/decisions` or chat completions. Questions can include text, images, audio, or video. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-decision-1).

daily.title: Gemini 4 Neon
daily.text: Use paid-only `google/gemini-4-neon` with text, image, audio, or video input. It returns text and supports reasoning, tools, native search, and a 1,048,576-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-4-neon).

daily.title: Gemini 3.8 Live
daily.text: Start realtime sessions with `google/gemini-3.8-live` using text, JPEG camera frames, or mono 24 kHz PCM16 audio. It streams speech, transcripts, and function calls for accounts using purchased Pollen; audio turns require an explicit commit and response request. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-3.8-live).

daily.title: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large
daily.text: Generate PNG images in nine aspect ratios, or edit with one reference image. This model requires a paid balance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=stability-ai%2Fstable-diffusion-3.5-large).

daily.title: Stable Image Core
daily.text: Generate PNG images in nine aspect ratios with this new paid-only model. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=stability-ai%2Fstable-image-core).

daily.title: Sunburst makes animated GIFs
daily.text: Request a GIF from GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst with `frame_count` from 2 to 16 and `frame_duration_ms` from 20 to 2000. It works through the image URL and `/v1/images/generations`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Hotshot-XL makes short GIFs
daily.text: Turn a prompt into an eight-frame, 512×512 GIF with `hotshotco/hotshot-xl` through the image API. It requires a paid balance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=hotshotco%2Fhotshot-xl).

daily.title: Ideogram makes editable SVGs
daily.text: Use `ideogram-ai/ideogram-vector-1` to make editable SVG artwork from a prompt or up to five reference images. It requires a paid balance and supports `low`, `medium`, and `high` quality. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=ideogram-ai%2Fideogram-vector-1).

daily.title: Arrow 2 makes editable SVGs
daily.text: Use `quiverai/arrow-2` for editable SVG illustrations, icons, and diagrams. Edits accept up to 14 reference images, and access requires a paid balance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=quiverai%2Farrow-2).

daily.title: LTX 2.5 Pro video
daily.text: Generate video with synchronized audio from text, with optional start and end frames. This paid-only model supports 720p or 1080p and clips of 6, 8, or 10 seconds. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=LTX%202.5%20Pro).

daily.title: Spot experimental models
daily.text: Experimental models now report `alpha: true` on `/v1/models` and `/v1/models/:model`. Stable models omit the field, so agents can check either endpoint without a second catalog request. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Show down models when needed
daily.text: Enter’s model catalog now hides models marked down by default. Use the status link to show them when you need the full list; direct model IDs and the API catalog are unchanged. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Qwen 4 Max added
daily.text: Use paid-only `qwen/qwen4-max` with text or image input, tools, reasoning, and a 1,000,000-token context. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen4-max).

daily.title: Clone a ZONOS voice
daily.text: Send a public HTTP(S) `reference_audio` URL with `zyphra/zonos3-mini` speech requests to generate text in that voice. Audio can be up to 20 MiB; the model uses its first 60 seconds. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Connect without an App Key
daily.text: Apps can sign users in through Pollinations Connect without an App Key. PKCE is still required; an App Key still enables app-name display, usage attribution, and developer earnings. [Read the React SDK guide](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/tree/main/packages/sdk#react-auth-provider).

daily.title: Quests, grouped by progress
daily.text: Browse Setup, Grow, Contribute, and Community tabs, then check claimable work and the separate monthly leaderboard. Quest amounts identify whether they add to Quest or Paid balance.

daily.title: Hy4 Flash joins text
daily.text: Use `tencent/hy4-flash` for text and image input, reasoning, and tools. It is paid-only and has a listed context length of 1,024,000 tokens. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=tencent/hy4-flash).

daily.title: DeepSeek Flash gains Quest access
daily.text: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 now accepts Quest balance as well as paid balance, with a 60 requests-per-minute per-user limit. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: GPT-6.2 Astra arrives
daily.text: Use paid-only `openai/gpt-6.2-astra` with text or image input, tools, and reasoning. It accepts up to 10 reference images and has a 1,050,000-token context; long-context pricing applies to the full request above 272,000 tokens. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6.2-astra).

daily.title: GPT-6.2 Sol arrives
daily.text: Use paid-only `openai/gpt-6.2-sol` with text or image input, tools, and reasoning. It has a 1,050,000-token context; long-context pricing applies to the full request above 272,000 tokens. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6.2-sol).

daily.title: MAI Image Flash arrives
daily.text: Generate or edit images with `microsoft/mai-image-2.7-flash`, using up to five reference images for edits. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/mai-image-2.7-flash).

daily.title: MAI Image 2.7 arrives
daily.text: Generate images from text or edit them with up to five reference images using `microsoft/mai-image-2.7`. It accepts Quest or paid balance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/mai-image-2.7).

daily.title: Microsoft decision model arrives
daily.text: Use `microsoft/microsoft-decision-1.1` to get typed choices and a probability for each fixed option through `/alpha/decisions` or `/v1/chat/completions`. It accepts Quest or paid balance and text-only requests. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/microsoft-decision-1.1).

daily.title: Liquid d1.2 joins decisions
daily.text: Send text or JSON state to `liquid/d1.2` and get structured choices, scores, and probabilities through `/alpha/decisions` or `/v1/chat/completions`. It uses paid balance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=liquid/d1.2).

daily.title: ZONOS3-Mini speech arrives
daily.text: Turn text into MP3 or PCM speech with paid-only `zyphra/zonos3-mini` using the `alloy` voice. Requests accept up to 10,000 text characters and a 64 KiB payload. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=zyphra/zonos3-mini).

daily.title: Give Sonilo a video
daily.text: Upload a reference video in Play and use `sonilo/sonilo-1.1-sfx` to add sound effects. Play shows the `reference_video` field in its API example. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Reference video in the SDK
daily.text: Pass `referenceVideo` to the SDK's `audioSpeech()` call for video-based sound effects. The SDK sends it as `reference_video`. [Browse the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Play remembers your run
daily.text: Leave Play and return during the same visit without losing your inputs, result, or in-flight run. Video controls now follow each model's supported options, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter starts a run. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Repeat Quest rewards stack
daily.text: Repeat rewards now appear on one card per activity, with earned amounts and links to each result. Claim waiting rewards together for one balance, then keep the card for the next reward. [Open the dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Agents can find MCP servers
daily.text: Use `listMcpServers` to discover other hosted MCP servers, including their tools, pricing, and alpha flags. [Browse MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Inspect Docker Hub tags
daily.text: The Packages MCP server can list tags for a public Docker Hub image or look up an exact tag. Results include its digest, size, last push time, and supported platforms. [Browse MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Exact math for agents
daily.text: The calculators MCP server gained `integer_math`, `convert_number_base`, and `check_digit`. Agents can work with large integers without number rounding, convert bases 2 through 36, and validate Luhn, IBAN, ISBN, and EAN-13 values. [Browse MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Look up ASN registrations
daily.text: Use `asn_whois` in the Network MCP server to look up an ASN's registered range, organization, country, status, and other RDAP details. [Browse MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: See required model checks
daily.text: OpenAI-compatible model listings now include `required_safety`, including mandatory checks inherited from fallbacks. Clients can read the checks without querying the registry separately; the checks themselves have not changed. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: See per-use model charges
daily.text: Model listings now include `pricing_adjustments` when a model has per-use charges beyond token pricing, such as Gemini search queries or cache storage. Models without adjustments omit the field. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Copy docs from dashboard cards
daily.text: Open the relevant guide from a dashboard card, or copy its text into an AI chat. The Keys card picks docs for your key type.

daily.title: Agents get their own page
daily.text: Browse Agents and MCP on dedicated pages. Manage your Agents, Models and Apps together in My listings.

daily.title: Browse sandbox starters
daily.text: Browse sandbox starter templates and prices without signing in. Sign in to create a sandbox or view yours.

daily.title: Keys in two tabs
daily.text: Switch between Secret and App keys in one card. Open the App tab directly with `/keys?tab=app`. [Open Keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Animated GIFs with Flare
daily.text: GPT Image 2.6 Flare can return PNG, WebP, or animated GIF. For GIFs, set `frame_count` from 2 to 16 and `frame_duration_ms` from 20 to 2000, within a 10-second total. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Model resolutions in the API
daily.text: `/v1/models` and `/v1/models/:model` now include `resolutions` when a model declares supported output sizes. Clients can use the field to choose a valid `resolution`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Research papers for agents
daily.text: Research MCP can search arXiv papers and Crossref works, then look up a paper by arXiv ID or a work by DOI. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Voice tools in MCP
daily.text: The Pollinations MCP server gained `isolateSpeech` and `changeVoice`. Pass a public HTTPS audio URL, or a video URL for speech isolation, and get an audio resource link back. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Check npm download counts
daily.text: The Packages MCP `package_downloads` tool retrieves daily npm downloads for a package. Choose a preset period or a custom date range of up to 18 months. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Look up Go and PHP packages
daily.text: Packages MCP can now look up Go modules and PHP Composer packages through `package_lookup`. Results include version details and links to the relevant package registry. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Inspect MAC addresses
daily.text: Network MCP's `inspect_mac` accepts common MAC address formats and reports normalized forms, the OUI prefix, and address flags. It runs locally without a network call. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: History on this day
daily.text: News MCP's `history_on_this_day` looks up selected events, deaths, or holidays for a calendar date using Wikimedia's public feed. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Exact calculations for agents
daily.text: Calculators MCP gained `to_fraction` for exact decimal and fraction reduction, `diff_text` for unified diffs, and `compare_versions` for SemVer ordering. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: First auto top-up Quest
daily.text: One paid auto top-up completed on or after October 13, 2026 qualifies an account for a one-time reward of 20 Quest Pollen. Existing auto top-up users can qualify with their next paid refill. [Explore Quests](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Out-of-Pollen dashboard banner
daily.text: Signed-in accounts with no spendable Pollen now see a dashboard banner linking to Buy Pollen. It also points to Quests when Quest Pollen is not locked.

daily.title: One Enter catalog card
daily.text: Enter now uses one responsive card layout for models, agents, MCP servers, and sandbox templates. Cards bring descriptions, capabilities, prices, and actions together, with model health shown as labeled bars. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Choose a sandbox template
daily.text: Compare sandbox templates by provider, size, hourly price, and Quest eligibility, then open creation with your choice selected. The Sandboxes page also shows running and paused states more clearly.

daily.title: Inspect media before editing
daily.text: Use the FFmpeg MCP tool `probeMedia` to inspect one public HTTPS media URL before choosing `runFfmpeg` arguments. It returns format and stream metadata as JSON, including duration, codecs, resolution, bitrate, and frame rate. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Hash text in MCP
daily.text: The calculators MCP tool `hash_text` hashes UTF-8 text locally and returns lowercase hex and base64 digests. It uses SHA-256 by default; SHA-1 is available for checksum compatibility. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Pick a decision model
daily.text: Ask Jev's `jev_decide` tool now accepts an optional `model` argument. Choose an accessible model that lists `/alpha/decisions` as a supported endpoint, or omit it to use the default Jev model. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Look up RubyGems
daily.text: The packages MCP tool `package_lookup` now fetches the current version of a Ruby gem or an exact version you specify. Results include dependencies, license, download counts, and yank status. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: ElevenLabs SFX v3
daily.text: Generate MP3 sound effects from text with `elevenlabs/eleven-text-to-sound-v3`. Set duration, looping, and prompt influence. Paid access is required. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenlabs/eleven-text-to-sound-v3).

daily.title: Scribe v3 batch transcription
daily.text: Transcribe audio with `elevenlabs/scribe-v3`, including word timestamps and speaker labels in supported response formats. Paid access is required. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenlabs/scribe-v3).

daily.title: Scribe v3 Live transcription
daily.text: Use `elevenlabs/scribe-v3-live` for realtime transcription sessions with incremental and final transcripts. Paid access is required. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenlabs/scribe-v3-live).

daily.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video
daily.text: Generate paid videos with `google/gemini-omni-1.2-flash` from text or up to two reference images. It supports start and end frames, synchronized audio, and 3 to 15 second output from 360p through 4K. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-omni-1.2-flash).

daily.title: Longer Wan 3.0 videos
daily.text: Choose any duration from 2 to 15 seconds for Wan 3.0 videos made from text, frames, or reference media. The default stays at 5 seconds. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Claude Fable 5.2 added
daily.text: Use paid-only `anthropic/claude-fable-5.2` for text and image input, tools, and adaptive reasoning. It has a 1M-token context window and accepts up to 20 reference images. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-fable-5.2).

daily.title: More details in model listings
daily.text: Check `/v1/models` for video controls and durations, preset audio voices, and declared reference image and video limits. Fields appear only where a model defines them. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Choose your model fallbacks
daily.text: Set `model` to up to four comma-separated model IDs or aliases. If an upstream attempt fails in a retryable way, the API tries the next eligible model in order. Entries must share a category and support the requested endpoint. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Compare sandbox templates
daily.text: The searchable Sandboxes tab shows five E2B and Azure templates, with sizes, hourly prices, 720-hour monthly estimates, the 75% launch discount, and a `polli sandbox create` command for each. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: More sandbox pricing details
daily.text: `GET /alpha/e2b/pricing` now includes each template's name, provider, size, and `diskSizeMB` alongside its existing fields. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: GPT Image 2.6 Flare
daily.text: Generate and edit images with `openai/gpt-image-2.6-flare`, using up to 16 reference images, transparency, and 4K output. It requires purchased Pollen. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-image-2.6-flare).

daily.title: GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst
daily.text: Generate and edit images with `openai/gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`, using up to 16 reference images, transparency, and 4K output. It requires purchased Pollen. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-image-2.6-sunburst).

daily.title: Invite friends for Pollen
daily.text: The new Invite friends quest awards 2 Quest Pollen for each qualifying referral whose purchases total more than 2 Pollen. Connect GitHub to copy your invite link from the Quests page.

daily.title: Contribution quests get reward labels
daily.text: From November 5, eligible PRs merged into main earn the PR's reward label, the highest label on a quest issue they close, or 5 Pollen by default. Eligible issue authors earn 2 Pollen.

daily.title: Pollinations agents in ACP editors
daily.text: Use `polli acp [agent]` in CLI 0.1.80 to run Pollinations agents in ACP editors such as Zed and JetBrains IDEs. Prompts can include images and files, and local tool calls require permission. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Code agents call your tools
daily.text: Pass function tools to a code agent through `/v1/responses`. The agent can return a call for your client to execute, then continue when you send the matching `function_call_output`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Barbara sends early warnings
daily.text: Mama Barbara sends a Telegram warning when an owner's sign-in is within two days of expiry or the remaining Pollen budget falls below one day of rent for running boxes. The warning includes `/signin`.

daily.title: Muse Spark Open
daily.text: Try `meta/muse-spark-open` with text or images, tools, and reasoning controls. Its context limit is 1,048,576 tokens; it requires reasoning and does not support `response_format` or `seed`. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=meta/muse-spark-open).

daily.title: Calculators MCP
daily.text: Use alpha MCP tools for time zones, cron previews, color contrast, Unicode inspection, QR codes, and ECB currency rates. The tools require a Pollinations key but charge no Pollen. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Network MCP
daily.text: Give an agent alpha tools for DNS lookups, public HTTP diagnostics, CIDR calculations, and domain or IP registration data. A Pollinations key is required, with no Pollen charge. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Packages MCP
daily.text: Look up npm, PyPI, and Rust crate dependencies, OSV advisories, and public Hugging Face model or Space metadata through read-only alpha tools. A Pollinations key is required, with no Pollen charge. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: News and Feeds MCP
daily.text: Read Hacker News, RSS and Atom feeds, Wayback capture links, and USGS earthquake data with alpha agent tools. A Pollinations key is required, with no Pollen charge. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Research MCP
daily.text: Give an agent alpha lookup tools for Wikipedia, Wiktionary, RFCs, Wikidata, Europe PMC, and World Bank data. A Pollinations key is required, with no Pollen charge. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Sandboxes That Pause
daily.text: Kept E2B sandboxes can opt into idle pause with `idleTimeout` of at least 300 seconds when their API timeout exceeds 600 seconds. A connection can resume a paused sandbox; waking it prepays a lease. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Share E2B Ports
daily.text: Share an E2B sandbox port with `PUT /alpha/e2b/sandboxes/<id>/ports/<port>` and reach it through a `pollinations.app` host. Authenticated requests can wake a paused sandbox, with the wake and lease prepaid through the sharing key. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Output Limits in Model Listings
daily.text: Read `top_provider.max_completion_tokens` from `/v1/models` or `/v1/models/:model`. The field is `null` when no output-token limit is declared. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
daily.text: Use `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash` with text or image input, tools, reasoning, and a 1,048,576-token context window. It does not require a paid balance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash).

daily.title: Two Kimi K3.1 Pro variants
daily.text: Try `moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro` or `moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed` for text and image input, tools, reasoning, and 1,048,576-token context windows. Both require a paid balance. [View Kimi K3.1 Pro](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro).

daily.title: Jev moves to 1.14
daily.text: Jev decision requests now use the pinned `typesafe/jev-1.14` release. Existing `jev`, `typesafe/jev`, and `typesafe/jev-1.13` names resolve to 1.14 too. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=typesafe/jev-1.14).

daily.title: Polli supports Mistral Vibe
daily.text: Use `polli harness vibe on|status|off` to set up Pollinations models in Mistral Vibe. It selects `openai/gpt-6-sol` by default, and `--model` lets you choose another tool-calling model. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Clearer community model results
daily.text: The Trust tab labels community models that error on more than half their eval questions as "endpoint errors" instead of showing a score gap. Score comparisons use answered questions as well as published scores.

daily.title: Model alerts reach their publishers
daily.text: Community Watch sends a separate Discord message for each model incident and pings the publisher's linked Discord account when available. Each message points to the model it concerns.

daily.title: Usage and earnings together
daily.text: Explore Usage and Earnings in one Activity view. Switch metrics, filter by model or key, inspect chart and table data, and export CSV.

daily.title: Claimable Quests come first
daily.text: Claimable Quests now appear at the top with a prominent Claim button. Open and completed Quests follow in that order.

daily.title: Community model checks
daily.text: Scheduled probes check public community text and image models with little traffic or poor health. Owners can get warnings for repeated model errors or frequent fallback rescues.

daily.title: A clearer My Apps view
daily.text: Browse your apps in a card grid with 24-hour request counts beside their titles. The grid uses two columns on wider screens and one on phones.

daily.title: Community model leaderboards
daily.text: Daily text and image boards show usage, speed, and success rates for public community models over the previous 24 hours. Text rankings require at least 50 requests per model; image rankings require at least 10. [Join Discord](https://discord.gg/k9F7SyTgqn).

daily.title: Community model status notices
daily.text: Community Watch posts when a listed community model relies substantially on fallbacks or moves in or out of model listings. A filtered model remains callable by its exact ID. [Join Discord](https://discord.gg/k9F7SyTgqn).

daily.title: Request a Setup reward review
daily.text: If your Setup Quest rewards are on hold, you can request an account review from the dashboard and see whether it is pending or declined. Other Quest rewards remain claimable.

daily.title: Verify a published Site
daily.text: Run `polli sites deploy --verify` to publish a Site, then check that every public file matches your local build. A failed check exits nonzero, but the Site remains published. [Explore the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Read model billing units
daily.text: `/v1/models` and `/v1/models/:model` can now return `pricing_units` when a model defines them. For some image and video models, this identifies `completionImageTokens` as priced per megapixel. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Grant missing key permissions
daily.text: Owners can use the grant link in Enter's 403 error, also returned as JSON `fixUrl`, to add missing `keys`, `machines`, or `usage` permission to an existing key. For keys obtained through a website redirect, add `keys` permission on the Keys page instead.

daily.title: Compare community model trust
daily.text: Model Monitor’s Community → Trust view compares each community model with the official model it is named after. Sort the latest weekly scores and see which differences clear the confidence threshold. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Find models and voices
daily.text: Use `polli models` to search models or filter by source and reliability. Add `--voices` to list voices by audio model. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Spot Pollen-related refusals
daily.text: The `/models/status` response now includes `errors_402` in model and route health data. It separates balance or key-budget refusals from other 4xx responses.

daily.title: Barbara can follow group chats
daily.text: Set a Barbara's Telegram group setting to Every message so she can read the conversation without being mentioned each time. She is instructed to answer unmentioned messages only when she has something useful to add.

daily.title: My Apps for everyone
daily.text: Every signed-in account can now open My Apps, including accounts with no listed apps. The page offers a way to submit an app and explains how approved listings appear.

daily.title: Model Monitor links in Discord
daily.text: Model Monitor links now have a Discord embed with direct buttons for model health and evals. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Tripo P2 text-to-3D
daily.text: Turn a text prompt of up to 1,024 characters into a GLB mesh with PBR textures using the alpha, paid-only `tripo3d/p2` model. It does not accept image input. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=tripo3d/p2).

daily.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Pro
daily.text: Generate or edit images with paid-balance model `qwen/qwen-image-2.1-pro`. The Alibaba route accepts up to 10 reference images and sizes up to 2560×2560; its fallback accepts at most four references and may return 2048×2048 for a 2560×2560 request. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen-image-2.1-pro).

daily.title: FLUX 3 Max video
daily.text: Make 5–20 second videos from text or up to two images used as start and end frames. Paid-balance model `black-forest-labs/flux-3-max` supports optional audio, 720p or 1080p output, and seven aspect ratios. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Muse Spark 1.3
daily.text: Use paid-only `meta/muse-spark-1.3` for text and image input, reasoning, and tools. It has a 1,048,576-token context window; Muse Spark 1.2 remains a separate model. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=meta/muse-spark-1.3).

daily.title: Experimental Glyph Cluster
daily.text: Try `stealth/glyph-cluster` for coding, long-context reasoning, and automatic tool calling. It is free during stealth for Quest and Paid users, with an 8-request-per-minute limit. Its provider may use prompts and responses for training and does not offer zero data retention. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=stealth/glyph-cluster).

daily.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
daily.text: Send text or images to paid-only `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl`. It supports tools, reasoning, structured output, and a 262,144-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl).

daily.title: Mercury 3
daily.text: Use paid-balance `inception/mercury-3` for text requests with tools, reasoning, and a 1,000,000-token context window. Its configured maximum output is 131,072 tokens; structured output is not in its supported-parameter set. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inception/mercury-3).

daily.title: D3 for decisions
daily.text: Use free, Quest-accessible `vllm-sr/d3` for typed choices, yes/no probabilities, and scores through `/alpha/decisions` or `/v1/systemone`. It is limited to 30 requests per minute, and its provider may log inputs and outputs for training. Do not send confidential data. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=vllm-sr/d3).

daily.title: Perplexity Decider V1.2
daily.text: Use `perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2` through decisions or chat requests. It replaces retired V1.1, and the old `perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` ID remains an alias. Access is paid-only. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2).

daily.title: Separate decision-key access
daily.text: Grant an API key the `decision` category to use decision models through `/alpha/decisions` without granting access to every text model. The category also appears in model listings, the SDK, and `polli models --type decision`. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Inspect recent agent runs
daily.text: Open an agent's Health panel in My Models to inspect up to 50 of your runs from the last seven days. See status, duration, Pollen charged, generation and tool-call counts, failed steps, and errors.

daily.title: Discord boost Quest
daily.text: Connect Discord and boost the Pollinations server to claim 20 Quest Pollen once per Discord account. [Join the Discord](https://discord.gg/k9F7SyTgqn).

daily.title: Model aliases in harnesses
daily.text: Pass a model ID or alias to `polli harness --model`. The CLI resolves aliases against `/v1/models` and saves the canonical ID in the harness config. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).
